test_title: PYST 2: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

Rest on his laurels

options.text: To bask in past glory and avoid current effort

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "To bask in past glory and avoid current effort".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Rest on his laurels"** means to be satisfied with past achievements and not make further efforts to progress or improve. (पुरानी उपलब्धियों पर संतुष्ट होकर आगे प्रयास न करना)
 
 
• **Example:** After winning several awards, he started resting on his laurels and stopped working hard.
 
 
• The correct meaning of the idiom is "To bask in past glory and avoid current effort". (पिछली प्रसिद्धि में मग्न रहना और वर्तमान प्रयासों से बचना)
 
 
• **Example:** The company cannot afford to rest on its laurels; it must continue to innovate to stay competitive.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To withdraw from success** (सफलता से पीछे हटना): This implies intentionally stepping away from success, which is not the meaning of the idiom.
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to withdraw from success and live a simpler life.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To criticize one’s own success** (अपनी सफलता की आलोचना करना): This means to find faults in one's achievements, which does not align with the meaning of "rest on his laurels".
 
 
• **Example:** She often criticizes her own success, saying she could have done better.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To challenge past achievements** (पिछली उपलब्धियों को चुनौती देना): This refers to striving to surpass one's previous accomplishments, which is opposite to the meaning of the idiom.
 
 
• **Example:** He constantly challenges his past achievements to improve further.
 
 

4c:T690,

The correct answer is **option 1.**
